messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
As of now, Tesla has **not officially launched** the Model S (or any other vehicle) in India, so there is no published retail price from Tesla itself.  

If you were to import a Model S into India, the cost would include:

| Item | Rough estimate |
|------|----------------|
| Base price (US$) | $90,000–$100,000 (depending on trim) |
| Import duty & GST | ~35–45 % of the vehicle’s value |
| Additional fees (registration, insurance, etc.) | ₹50,000–₹1,00,000 |

Adding those together, a rough ballpark for an imported Model S would be **around ₹1.5 crore to ₹2 crore** (≈$200,000–$260,000), depending on the exact trim and the prevailing exchange rate.

Until Tesla announces an official launch and pricing in India, this figure remains an estimate based on import costs and typical Indian automotive taxes.
